slides.title: Serverless Python Execution
slides.prompt: Serverless platforms (AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions) execute Python handlers on demand without server management.

slides.title: AWS Lambda Entry Function
slides.prompt: Fill in the default function signature parameter representing incoming event payload data.

slides.title: Mitigating Cold Starts
slides.prompt: What technique effectively reduces cold start latency in production serverless Python functions?
options: Using Provisioned Concurrency or optimizing package bundle import sizes
Running function handlers inside continuous loops
Converting all code files into HTML
slides.correctAnswer: Using Provisioned Concurrency or optimizing package bundle import sizes

slides.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
slides.prompt: Fill in the framework used to declare cloud infrastructure using Python code instead of raw JSON/YAML.

slides.title: Cloud Object Storage Integration
slides.prompt: Which official AWS SDK library is standard for interacting with S3, DynamoDB, and SQ3 in Python?

slides.title: Boto3 Client Initialization
slides.prompt: Fill in the boto3 method used to create low-level service clients.

slides.title: Stateless Serverless Scaling
slides.prompt: How do serverless platforms handle sudden spikes of incoming HTTP traffic?
options: By automatically spawning isolated execution environment instances in parallel
By queueing all requests until the single running worker finishes
By rebooting the entire cloud region
By temporarily dropping 50% of incoming requests
slides.correctAnswer: By automatically spawning isolated execution environment instances in parallel
